thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert — high QPS observed for org helixcorp. Threshold(standard org qps) tripped at 12:34 UTC. Auto-mitigation not sufficient.

pagerduty: Pager #12345 triggered, severity: high. Assigned to @Sara H (on-call).

Sara H: I'm on the page. grabbing metrics now. anyone seen correlated errors?

Miguel R: looking at dashboard — steady spike from helixcorp web tier hitting concurrency on text-generation route `/v1/generate`. 95th latency up to 3.2s, errors still low (5xx ~0.2%). QPS ~12k (org limit 5k).

Elaine K: interesting — they switched to a new batch client yesterday? CS said they rolled a change. @CS_Liaison any details?

CS_Liaison: HelixCorp pushed a release at 08:00 local that enabled parallel generation across many users. They're aware of increased traffic, asked for a temporary bump request earlier but we didn't have approval flow fast enough.

Ravi P: we need a fast mitigation — options: 1) temp qps bump for org, 2) apply org-level token bucket to slow burst, 3) disable non-critical endpoints (e.g., embeddings rerank) for that org.

Max G: I can do a quick override. prefer token-bucket to preserve fairness. can perform a tactical QPS increase as well.

Sara H: prioritize customer-facing continuity. do the minimal change with fastest revert. Ravi/Max — which is fastest?

Max G: `redctl` will do it. quick command:
```
# bump helixcorp org QPS to 15k for 30m
redctl org adjust-qps --org helixcorp --qps 15000 --duration 30m --note "emergency spike mitigation 2068880000"
```
This will update gateway routing and take ~15s to propagate.

Miguel R: Also recommend enabling soft-throttle on heavy endpoints to smooth spikes: `redctl org set-throttle --org helixcorp --route "/v1/generate" --max-burst 200 --sustained 12000`

Elaine K: can we also add a temporary rule to route non-critical traffic to cheaper fallback model to reduce GPU pressure?

Max G: I can update routing to fallback variant for `generate` with `--fallback-model=gpt-lite` in the same window. one command: 
```
redctl route override --org helixcorp --route "/v1/generate" --fallback-model gpt-lite --duration 30m
```

Sara H: proceed with QPS bump + soft-throttle + fallback. I'll own the change set and watch. @deploy-bot stand by for audit log.

deploy-bot: Starting operator actions: 1) adjust-qps 2) set-throttle 3) route override. Audit ID: AUD-2068880000-7.

Max G: executed `adjust-qps` — no errors, control-plane acked. propagation ~10s.

Max G: executed `set-throttle` and `route override`. All three commands returned 200 and audit entries created.

Miguel R: seeing immediate effect — org QPS dropped to ~9.8k sustained (requests that hit fallback model shown separately). 95th latency down to ~1.1s, GPU occupancy decreased by ~35%.

Sara H: good. keep monitoring. if errors creep up or latency resurges, we rollback to previous config.

CS_Liaison: I'll open a support note to HelixCorp and let them know we applied a temporary override for 30m and ask them to rollback the client change or throttle on their side. Drafting message now.

CS_Liaison: (message sent to customer) "We've applied a temporary QPS increase and routing fallback to protect your traffic while we investigate. Please consider throttling parallel requests — we'll follow up in 15m with metrics."

Ravi P: watch for cross-org impact. I'm checking global capacity; other orgs unaffected so far.

Miguel R: adding a quick smoke check on other tenants — nothing abnormal.

Sara H: can someone create an incident timeline and add to postmortem tracker? I'll mark this as mitigated once the 30m expirs and we confirm stable.

Max G: Created incident timeline: https://redwood.internal/incidents/AUD-2068880000 (private).

deploy-bot: Reminder: automatic revert at 2068881800 UTC for temporary changes.

Sara H: noted. leaving watch for 30m. ping me if anything spikes again.

Miguel R: agree. I'll keep a 15m polling for metrics.

Elaine K: follow-up item: engineering to propose a faster customer-facing QPS escalation path and CS approval flow. filing ticket.

CS_Liaison: helixcorp replied — they accepted the temporary change and will throttle client in next release. appreciate quick response. :thumbsup:

Sara H: thanks everyone. closing watch at 2068881800 if stable; incident will be converted into a postmortem for process improvements.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation confirmed. Temporary overrides reverted at 2068881800 as scheduled. Incident status: resolved.
